summary: Ted, the field CTO for integration at Qlik, discusses the evolution of AI and its impact on data analytics and integration. He emphasizes the importance of context and trust in leveraging data effectively within organizations. The session outlines challenges faced by organizations and introduces key pillars for overcoming these challenges using Qlik's tools.

key_points: Audience participation on AI tool usage
Importance of context and trust in data

sections.topic: Pillars of AI and Data Integration
key_points: The role of context and trust in AI
Combining CPU and GPU for analytics
Building an agentic framework for data quality

key_takeaways: AI is revolutionizing the data analytics industry by changing how we interact with software.
Context and trust are essential for deriving value from data in any organization.
Organizations should focus on defining clear use cases to drive data integration and analytics.
